title: Sample 1 - rheumatoid arthritis patient vs. a joint-pain trial (synthetic)
note:
0. A 52-year-old woman presents with swelling and pain in both wrists and knees for six months.
1. She has long-standing rheumatoid arthritis and takes methotrexate and prednisone 10 mg daily.
2. She has no history of cancer.
3. Vital signs are stable.
4. The patient is willing to participate in the trial.
exclusion: History of chronic systemic autoimmune disorders such as rheumatoid arthritis
Concurrent use of systemic immunosuppressive therapy or long-term corticosteroids

title: Sample 2 - short note with missing information (synthetic)
note:
0. A 67-year-old man presents with a three-day history of productive cough and shortness of breath.
1. He has smoked one pack of cigarettes daily for 40 years.
2. On examination he has diffuse wheezing and oxygen saturation of 91% on room air.
inclusion: Diagnosis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease confirmed by spirometry
Current or former smoker with at least 10 pack-years
exclusion: Participation in another interventional trial within 30 days

title: Sample 3 - diabetes trial with an inapplicable and a contradicted criterion (synthetic)
note:
0. A 45-year-old man has had type 2 diabetes mellitus for eight years.
1. His most recent HbA1c was 6.4% on metformin alone.
2. He has never had a myocardial infarction or stroke.
3. Creatinine clearance was measured at 45 mL/min last month.
4. He drinks alcohol rarely and does not smoke.
inclusion: HbA1c of 7.5% or higher despite metformin therapy
Women of childbearing potential must use effective contraception
